biography.plain_text: Thomas Michael Zizic is an American rheumatologist, medical educator and co-founder of BioniCare Medical Technologies. Trained at Johns Hopkins, he combined clinical practice with research into arthritis and related conditions before leading the medical-device company. In retirement, he has endowed a rheumatology professorship and a translational research fund at Johns Hopkins.

long_biography.plain_text:
BioniCare Medical Technologies translated Thomas M. Zizic’s rheumatology experience into a medical-device business focused on non-invasive treatment. He served as founder, president and chief executive after decades of clinical and academic work in arthritis, osteonecrosis and osteoporosis.

Zizic trained at Johns Hopkins and later taught and practised within its medical community. His philanthropy has returned to the same institution through an endowed professorship in rheumatology and immunology and a fund supporting the movement of research towards practical application. The translational fund backs projects intended to move discoveries from laboratory work towards clinical use.
